Tessera plugin VERSION for Windows (64-bit)
===========================================

In this folder:
  Tessera.clap    the CLAP instrument (use this one if your DAW has CLAP: Bitwig, Reaper, FL Studio, ...)
  Tessera.vst3    the VST3 instrument
  Tessera.exe     the standalone app: no DAW needed

Install
-------
1. Copy Tessera.clap to   C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\
   Copy Tessera.vst3 to   C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
   (Make the CLAP folder if it isn't there. Windows asks for an administrator's OK to copy there.)
2. In your DAW, rescan the plugins. Tessera is an instrument, under "Tessera".

The standalone app needs no install: double-click Tessera.exe and pick an audio output.

"Windows protected your PC"
---------------------------
This beta isn't signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about Tessera.exe the first time. Click
"More info", then "Run anyway". The plugins themselves are loaded by your DAW and don't show this.

If Windows blocks the downloaded zip's files: right-click the zip, Properties, tick "Unblock", OK,
then unzip again.

The manual for the plugin: https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/blob/main/PLUGIN.md
What's in this beta, and what isn't yet: BETA_NOTES.md in this folder.
Found a problem? https://github.com/Rastapopolix/tessera/issues (the plugin's version, your DAW and its
version, Windows' version, the steps, what you expected and what happened).
